description: Let's create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions.
summary:
We developed an intuitive health-monitoring application designed to help astronauts track and understand their health during space missions. The application presents key health statistics in a clear, organized, and visually engaging interface, allowing astronauts to quickly assess their physical well-being.

Our project addresses the challenge of maintaining astronauts' health during long-duration missions, where limited access to medical professionals makes self-monitoring especially important. By making health data more accessible and understandable, the application supports better health awareness, early identification of potential issues, and more informed decisions.
details:
Project Overview & How It Works
Our project is a lightweight Astronaut Health Monitoring Dashboard designed to help crew members independently track and manage their well-being during long-duration space missions. Using simulated mission datasets (tracking heart rate, muscle mass, mood, and sleep quality), the system evaluates health indicators and translates them into clear insights. Through automated conditional formatting (green, yellow, red alerts) and dynamic text recommendations, the dashboard immediately informs astronauts when a metric drops and suggests specific corrective actions—such as adjusting workout routines. Additionally, based on the astronaut's selected mood, the system dynamically displays personalized cosmic mood messages (such as relaxation prompts or morale-lifting notes) to support behavioral health in isolation.

Key Benefits & Intended Impact
In deep space, communication delays with Earth mean astronauts must spot physical and psychological issues early on their own. Our dashboard reduces cognitive load for fatigued crew members by replacing complex medical charts with instant visual alerts and actionable advice.

Tools & Software Used
We built the entire analytical engine, simulated database, and user interface in Microsoft Excel, utilizing nested logical formulas for automated recommendations and cosmic mood messages, data validation for mood selection, and conditional formatting.

Creativity & Design Considerations
Rather than building heavy software prone to crashes, using Excel ensures our system is reliable, transparent, and easily modifiable by the crew itself without needing large software updates from Earth. We focused heavily on User Experience (UX), prioritizing high readability and instant status recognition in isolated, high-stress environments.
